objective: Preallocate collecting aggregate accumulators for their first input value.

tasks.title: Preallocate aggregate first input
tasks.result: Collecting aggregate accumulators now reserve capacity for the first input value when created through AggregateAccumulator::new.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The initial capacity is 1 because new COUNT_DISTINCT, ARRAY_AGG, STRING_AGG, and GROUP_CONCAT accumulators are typically followed by the first aggregate input update.
The optimization only changes initial HashSet/Vec allocation for collecting accumulators; update, NULL handling, finalization, and SQL aggregate results are unchanged.
